abstract: The records and histopathology of 4 patients with primary mediastinal seminoma were reviewed. All of them were male and at presentation had one or more poor prognostic factors, namely superior vena cava obstruction, hilar lymphadenopathy, bulky tumor, and raised alpha-fetoprotein titers. Their treatment consisted partly or entirely of chemotherapy. Three of them survived free of disease 2-5 years off treatment, 1 of them died of pulmonary fibrosis with no tumor found at postmortem examination. The prognostic factors and treatment of this tumor and the risk of combined radiotherapy and chemotherapy containing bleomycin are discussed.
abstract_ja: 原発性縦隔セミノーマの患者4例の記録と病理組織学を再検討した。全例が男性で、初診時に上大静脈閉塞、肺門リンパ節腫脹、巨大腫瘍、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値の上昇といった予後不良因子を1つ以上有していた。治療は一部または全例が化学療法からなっていた。3例は治療終了後2〜5年間無病生存し、1例は肺線維症で死亡したが、剖検で腫瘍は認められなかった。本腫瘍の予後因子と治療、およびブレオマイシンを含む併用放射線療法と化学療法のリスクについて考察する。
